alternative_explanations: Any gain may reflect generic smoothing or support regularization rather than portable dynamics; a loss may reflect the deliberately scalar exchangeable rule rather than all shared learners.
confounds: Invalidate on family labels, native types, paths, semantic channel alignment, output-coordinate-specific learned parameters, training-world-order dependence, train/test overlap, test-output access, source or hyperparameter differences across causal roles, post-score tuning, certificate mismatch, budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard this exact ridge-0.001 prior-weight-0.25 residual-clip-0.25 state-clip-8 learner if either causal gain is non-positive in any family, any rollout is unstable or out of bounds, shared overall or minimum-family accuracy fails to exceed persistence, or a simpler implementable baseline dominates it.

outcome_policy.negative: Discard this exact bounded residual mechanism if a preregistered causal contrast fails in any family or persistence/simple control dominates; a crash rejects the implementation while integrity failure invalidates the experiment.
outcome_policy.null: Treat near-zero or mixed-sign causal gains as inconclusive-to-negative for this exact learner and do not tune its frozen constants against the observed seed.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-seed screen of the exact learner and controls; do not mark promising, promote, claim scaling, general intelligence or an LLM successor.

predicted_outcome: The shared learner has strictly positive shared-versus-independent and cross-family-transfer gains overall and in every family, stable bounded rollouts, transfer accuracy and minimum-family accuracy above persistence, and implementable Pareto non-dominance after full cost; a valid negative is plausible.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. A valid one-seed conjunctive positive may authorize only an unchanged three-runner-seed screen.
research_question: Can one channel-exchangeable bounded residual rule transfer across three unseen world families with better quality per fully charged cost than source-identical causal ablations and persistence?
title: Exchangeable bounded residual transfer around persistence
